title: Matte Black
description: Standard minimal color for maximum statement.
calibrationNote: Calibrated from the matte black sample image to stay in the near-black family with the flattest surface response in the set.
calibrationImageAssessment: Sample reads consistently dark with manageable lighting bias; use it as the anchor for black finish comparisons.

title: Satin Black
description: A more "refined" black finish with medium reflection.
calibrationNote: Kept adjacent to Matte Black in hue while lowering roughness so the satin finish separates under studio highlights.
calibrationImageAssessment: Sample has moderate hotspot bias, but it is still suitable as the gloss reference for the black finishes.

title: Oil Rubbed Bronze
description: A dark earthen tone, close to black but less stark.
calibrationNote: Biased toward a near-black brown-bronze read so it stays only slightly lighter than the black finishes without drifting into bright brass.
calibrationImageAssessment: Sample includes warm reflected light; match the bronze family and overall depth, not the brightest edges.

title: Satin Bronze
description: A dulled gold finish for a sense of luxury.
calibrationNote: Tuned lighter and more reflective than Oil Rubbed Bronze so the satin bronze option reads like a warmer premium metal finish.
calibrationImageAssessment: Sample is usable for hue and brightness, though bright reflections should not be copied directly.

title: Gunmetal Grey
description: A medium grey that blends without disappearing.
calibrationNote: Lifted to the prior titanium-silver lightness target while keeping a matte, cool gunmetal surface response.
calibrationImageAssessment: Sample provides a solid mid-dark neutral target with moderate lighting bias.

title: Titanium Silver
description: A bright silver finish that resembles fine hardware.
calibrationNote: Rebalanced toward a brighter silver body tone with a controlled metallic response so the finish stays silver off-axis instead of collapsing into dark mirror reflections.
calibrationImageAssessment: Sample is highly reflective and lighting-biased; use it for relative brightness only, not highlight intensity.

title: Raw Metal
description: A clear-coat that preserves the industrious look of steel.
calibrationNote: Brightened substantially while staying dimmer and less polished than Titanium Silver so raw metal still reads industrial.
calibrationImageAssessment: Sample likely exaggerates contrast from surface reflections; use it as a family reference and candidate for a flatter swatch later.

title: Custom
calibrationNote: Intentionally neutral fallback preview that avoids implying a specific production finish before the custom selection is quoted.
calibrationImageAssessment: Current reference image behaves like a placeholder stainless sample and should not be treated as a final custom-finish target.
